lines.en: label rinspring8:
scene rinmaidtime1
: Two, please.
: But I also didn’t mean today...
: M-Master! And...Lady Master! Hi! Uhh...you two have never come here together before! How...curious!
scene rinmaidtime2
: How many girls have you come here with?
: I’ve lost count, to be honest. I enter a trance-like state when I’m in here because Uta is too good at her job.
: Anything for my precious princes and princesses! And what joy it brings me to be able to serve both of you at once today!
scene rinmaidtime3
: Oh, sorry. We’re actually here for Chika. I want her to serve us.
: How about both of you serve us? Without clothes on.
: I think that’s illegal.
: When has that ever stopped me?
scene rinmaidtime4
: Hey — we have a mission, remember? This is no time to be instilling new fantasies in me. The last thing we want is me falling for Uta next when we’re so close to the finish line.
: H...How close exactly? If I’m...allowed to ask. Out of character.
scene rinmaidtime5
: Not that close, I guess. All we’ve really done is kiss so far.
: Oh, same.
scene rinmaidtime6
: Hey, cool! Mouth-twins!
: I don’t like how casual this is becoming for everyone. It sometimes feels like I’m the one being strung along at this point.
: Soooo...table for two? Are you sure? Or do you maybe want to separate and I can serve the handsome Master while Chika-chan takes care of you?
: We need to sit together, unfortunately. I want to ruin Chika’s day.
: I feel as if I’ve somehow become a third wheel on my own date.
: Cars need four wheels to drive! Double date! I get him!
scene rinmaidtime7
: When did you get this openly thirsty?
: Like 2015 something. I just hide it well. Chika-chan! You have customers!
: Haaaaai!
scene rinmaidtime8
: Boy, I sure can’t wait to sit down and chat with our maid! I bet she’s really-
scene rinmaidtime9
: AAAAAAHHHH!
scene rinmaidtime10
: Hm? What was-
scene rinmaidtime11
: AAAAAAAAHHHH!
: YOU CHANGED YOUR HAIR BACK!
: W-W-W-W-WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE? LEAVE! GO!
: NO! My BOYFRIEND and I would like an omelet! One omelet! Served to us by a hot Filipina maid that we can share!
: The maid or the omelet?
: WHO KNOWS?!
: Chika-chan? Who are they?
: Yeah, you’re not ignoring us in favor of other customers, are you?
scene rinmaidtime12

: What did I tell you about speaking before you’re spoken to, you trashy, donkey-fucking whore? I will never love you and I will cut your fucking tongue off if you refuse to learn the rules. Do you understand?
: Is this really the maid you guys wanted when there’s that cute redhead working here? Why?
: You just don’t get it, Tiffany.
: So do we just seat ourselves or what?
scene rinmaidtime13
: Yes! Somewhere else! Because I suddenly have to go on break for the exact amount of time that you’re going to be here!
: Oh, great. We’ll go with you then. I’ve always wondered what the locker room looks like. Specifically while there are girls in it getting dressed and/or undressed.
: Uta! Some help, please! We’re allowed to refuse customers, right?!
: Not unless they’re foreigners. Upper management cares way more about our Tabelog score than our Google Reviews one.
: I think you’re just going to have to do it, Chika. I’ve already tried to-
scene rinmaidtime14
: No! You can’t make me!
: Ch-Chika, wait! You can’t just run away in the middle of a shift!
: Then I quit!
: Just what the fuck happened between you guys? My existence has barely been acknowledged.
: All going according to plan, I’d say. Thanks for the idea, Sensei. You can leave the rest to me now.
: Uhh...you guys can just take a seat at that empty table over there. I need to go...repair the number two maid before the rankings change.
scene rinmaidtime15
: So, are you going to tell me what’s really going on now that I have been sucked into some sort of teenage drama?
: Chika doesn’t want to be friends with me anymore because of reasons. Mostly she just thinks she’s crazy now. Which she is.
: But why will cutting you out fix that? You’re not what’s making her crazy, I am.
: I think we both are in different ways. And that you’re not far from being cut out too, so we should band together right now and force her to keep spending time with us.
: Even at the expense of her happiness and who she hopes to be as a person?
: Yes. Even at the expense of those things.
: Rin, are you actually evil?
scene rinmaidtime16
: No! What’s evil is that someone could do something so self-motivated without any regard for how the person they’re doing it to feels! Especially when that person loves her a lot!
: So...exactly what you’re doing right now?
: Yes, but you don’t have to point it out!
: I get it. I mean, you’re here with me. A man who constantly does self-motivated things at the cost of others.
scene rinmaidtime17
: Sure. But it’s normal when you do that because that’s how you’ve always been. So of course I’m going to think sudden changes in Chika are a lot more...malleable. I can fix her.
: Well, I sincerely apologize that you feel inclined to fix the things that I have broken. And I hope forcing her into an uncomfortable situation accomplishes that for you.
: Anyway, when can we make out?
scene rinmaidtime18
: I’ll jump across the table once she comes back out and start kissing you. Then you can count until five and start taking my clothes off.
scene rinmaidtime19
: Well, you guys are certainly a lot closer all of a sudden. I’m afraid I can’t let you do that, though. Even if it is, like, years overdue at this point.
: Hi, Ami. Rest assured, I am only here to make Chika’s life harder today. And if it helps preserve our friendship, I will wait until I am alone with your dad to let him take my clothes off.
scene rinmaidtime20
: That’s really all I ask at this point. Thank you, Rin.
: Hi, Ami. Still last place in the popularity rankings?
scene rinmaidtime21
: Unfortunately, yeah. But I’ve been thinking about pivoting to a more incest-focused character in the future so I can play better to my strengths.
: It’s just all girls, though. And I’ve found that most girls don’t really like it when you call them “Daddy.”
: I’ll let you call me “Daddy” if you want to.
scene rinmaidtime22
: No thanks. That’ll just make things confusing when you inevitably start having sex with mine.
: What’s wrong with two dads having sex together?
: Nothing so long as I’m in the room. Keep that in mind when the time comes.
: Uhh...okay.
: Ahem.
scene rinmaidtime23
: Hi.
: Ami, could you go check if Chika’s ready to come out yet?
: Can you promise to select me the next time you come here so I can stop feeling bad about you choosing Uta instead?
: How about you just wear the outfit while making dinner for me tonight? Does that work?
scene rinmaidtime24
: Chika! Can you get out here and do your frickin’ job already before we wind up having to stop those two from having sex on the table?!
: You two have a weird relationship, Sensei. I can’t help but get grossed out whenever my mom talks about stuff like that and here you are letting her wear a maid costume around the house.
: She can wear the costume and have it still be wholesome.
scene rinmaidtime25
: Then you’re stronger than me because I can not see that dress as anything other than an article of clothing specifically designed to tear off in the heat of a horny rampage.
: So if your mom were to wear the dress-
: Sensei, please. We are in a restaurant.
scene rinmaidtime26
: Hi. Me again. So, cuttin’ right to the chase, we’ve got a bit of an issue.
: What kind of issue, Uta? Because I’ll have you know that I do have a Tabelog account and I am not afraid to use it.
: Right, yeah. So, that’s fine. And if you really want Chika to be the one to take care of you guys, I’ll make it happen. But, like...is that really what you want?
: Yes.
scene rinmaidtime27
: Over me?
: Yes.
: Uta-chan.
: Yes.
: The girl who is specifically designed to appeal to everyone, boys and girls alike, who has an almost perfect track record when it comes to customer care and satisfaction?
: Yes.
: What if I offer to comp your meals?
: I still want Chika.
scene rinmaidtime28
: What if I take my top off?!
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh.............
: Really?
: Uta, I can’t believe I’m saying this, but don’t take your top off.
scene rinmaidtime29
: I can’t believe you’re saying this either! You’ve been tryin’ to see Uta-chan’s mini-Utas for as long as you’ve been coming here! Why’s this not working?! Am I not cute anymore?!
: You’re adorable, Uta. I just kind of need it to be Chika because I can’t get her to talk to me under any other circumstance and must now use force.
scene rinmaidtime30
: Which would be fine...if she was not having a total episode right now.
: Well, how much longer until her episode ends? We don’t mind waiting.
: Uhhh...
: Let me go check.
scene rinmaidtime31
: FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!!! WHY?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!!
: J-J-J-Just treat them like any other customers, Chika! Put your game face on and get back in character! It should be easy with all the crazy-person practice you’ve gotten lately!
scene rinmaidtime32
: What’s easy about being confronted at work when I told her to stay away from me?! Isn’t this crossing a line?!
: A bunch of them! But if Rin was the one who cut you off, I bet you’d suddenly feel a lot more inclined to go buy overpriced coffee, right?
: It’s not my fault Koi Cafe is the only place in town where I can get a pumpkin spice latte year round! Sue me, Uta! Fucking sue me!
: Just go out there and treat her like any other guest. And Sensei’s there too! You love him, right? Just lean on him for support.
: Yeah, I’m sure he’ll love hearing about the time I ate out his date! Or how pissed off I get at the thought of him touching her because I want her to belong to ME and me only!
: Oof.
scene rinmaidtime33
: Oh fuck off, ampota! I’ve done things with your dad that would give you fucking nightmares! Huwag ka nang magsalita!
: It’ll be hard, sure. But you’re going to have to deal with things like this for a little while, Chika. It’s totally fair that Rin wouldn’t just roll over and let you go without a fight.
scene rinmaidtime34
: So?! That doesn’t make it any less hard!
: She’s doing this on purpose just to piss me off! I hate it! And in this fucking costume, it feels so fucking demeaning! Like I’m a fucking toy for her to use and-
scene rinmaidtime35
: Great! Now I’m horny too! Could today get any fucking worse?!
: Just go take their order at least. You can skip the small talk and blah, blah, blah. But you can’t let her get to you like this or it’ll happen everywhere.
: I can’t!
: Chika, look at me.
scene rinmaidtime36
: You are a strong, independent maid who don’t need no man or woman! Say it with me!
: No.
: Fair enough! But the fact remains that you are way more mature than you give yourself credit for! You’ve done a million bigger things than this! You can overcome anything if you try!
: That’s the Chika-chan I know! Not this one who folds just because there’s a cute girl she can’t currently handle! You got that?!
: Sniff...Thank you, Uta. But if I ever take sexual advantage of you and then tell you to go away, please just listen. This is hard.
: Great! Now I’m horny too! You are tearing this cafe apart!
scene black
: Now, get out there and show the world that maids mean business! Make them feel stupid for ever coming here at all!
: Yeah, what’s the worst that could happen? You break down in front of them and reveal your sins to Sensei who then decides to cut you off and you’re left with literally nobody?
: Alis! Huwag kang humarang diyan!
scene rinmaidtime37
: Why, if it isn’t our very own Chika-chan, finally here to take our order. Why did you change your hair?
: The same reason you changed yours...Now, what can I get for you?
: I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it yet. In fact, it might take me a really long time to do that. So why don’t you take my boyfriend’s order first?
scene rinmaidtime38
: So, did she come to you specifically to try and get back at me or what?
: I think this might actually be my fault on a technical level. I’m pretty sure she just wanted to hang out. I had no idea it would snowball into whatever is happening right now.
: So you just don’t even know?
: I know there is something I don’t know. And that I’ll find out eventually. But yeah, right now I’m kind of just confused and hungry and mildly aroused.
: That’s pretty much my baseline, so I can relate.
scene rinmaidtime39
: Are you proud of yourself for this? Do you really have no idea how much it hurts?
: Oh, no. I want it to hurt. I want you to spend every waking moment agonizing over it since that’s what I’ve had to do since Christmalloween. Seems only fair to me.
: You could have saved yourself a trip and some money by knowing that I already have been agonizing, Rin. All this is doing is wasting your time.
: Oh, silly me. It’s just hard for me to know anything when you won’t even make eye contact with me at school, coward.
: I’m making it now, aren’t I?
: You sure are. And how does that feel, Chika?
: Like a million icepicks being forced beneath my nails while someone drills holes into my heart.
: If I didn’t know any better, I’d assume the two of you have been secretly dating or something.
scene rinmaidtime40
: Or something, for sure.
: Listen, if you two aren’t ready to order yet, I’ll give you another few minutes and come back. Okay? Okay. Bye.
: One omelet, Chika. And whatever today’s special parfait is.
scene rinmaidtime41
: Could you tell us what that is, by the way? I’ve been so focused on my boyfriend that I haven’t even looked at the menu yet.
: Hah...really?
: Really.
: It’s the very merry cherry berry prince and princess parfait, made with five different types of berries, a splash of love, and a kiss mixed in.
: Sounds delightful. Could I get an extra kiss with mine?
: No modifications. Everything is sold as-is.
: Not even for me? Then how will I know you love me?
: I’ll be back soon with your order.
scene rinmaidtime42
: Wow, Rin. You’re, uhh...really giving her a tough time today.
: Only because I have to. I’ve been avoided for so long that I’m kind of furious, to be honest.
: Sorry if it’s killing the vibe. I’ll go back to normal after this. Just felt like I needed to jump on the opportunity since we don’t exactly get to chill as much as we used to.
: Which you do want to...right?
: Of course. Why wouldn’t I?
: You just seem a little more focused on Chika right now. Which is fine if that’s where your heart is again. I mean, I get it. You’ve always kind of-
scene rinmaidtime43
: That’s not what’s happening this time. I promise.
if harukasex == True:
: You’re the one I like. Even if you’re sleeping with all of my friends, my roommate, my teacher, my boss, and now also my mom.
else:
: You’re the one I like. Even if you’re sleeping with all of my friends, my roommate, my teacher, and now also my mom.
: That makes it sound like you’re just feeling left out.
: I am. And I love what we have, don’t get me wrong, but you’ve felt a million other things with a million other girls now and I want to feel those things too.
: Especially if it feeds the sex demon that now lives inside of me after Otoha fingered me so many times. It’s like some sort of emotional STD or something.
: Well, here’s hoping I can live up to her.
: No pressure, but it’ll be a real bummer if you can’t. She was good.
: I will...keep that in mind, Rin. And let the record show that I like you too. Even if I am the third wheel right now.
: Just for now. But, like I said, after this, we’re-
scene rinmaidtime44
: Eat.
: Oh, wow. So fast. I guess the service here really is-
scene rinmaidtime45
: ...What?
: Eat.
: Eat.
: Chika...what the fuck is that?
: Food.
: Eat.
scene rinmaidtime46
: What...why is everyone-
: Eat.
: What’s wrong, Rin?
